entries.name: Warm Stew
entries.description: Comforting food. Endurance +2 next battle. Requires bear hide + ice crystal — gather, buy, or harvest from Pocket Haven.

entries.name: Frostcap Skewer
entries.description: Light field food. Perception +2 next battle. Cooked from a Frostcap mushroom dusted with sprite essence.

entries.name: Hunter's Brew
entries.description: A bracing brew. Strength +2 next battle. Trophy-grade ingredients only.

entries.name: Fresh Fish
entries.description: Raw fish. Cook at a station for a stamina buff.

entries.name: Silver Trout
entries.description: A glittering trout. Eat raw for +1 Agility next battle, or cook for a longer agility surge.

entries.name: Coral Snapper
entries.description: Reef-fresh fish. Cook for sustained HP regen.

entries.name: Void Eel
entries.description: Wriggling deep-water predator. Cooking unlocks a magic-power surge.

entries.name: Mire Catfish
entries.description: Surprisingly tasty once cooked. Grants poison resistance.

entries.name: Emberfin Pike
entries.description: Hunts in molten currents. Spicy. Cook to boost fire damage.

entries.name: Lantern Jelly
entries.description: Glowing jelly. Cook to enhance vision range.

entries.name: Thunder Carp
entries.description: Static-charged carp. Cook for a lightning-damage boost.

entries.name: Moonlit Koi
entries.description: Legendary. Cooked, grants +1 to all stats.

entries.name: Dragon Tuna
entries.description: Legendary. Cooked, fills 50% of the ultimate meter.

entries.name: Scrap Stew
entries.description: Whatever was left. Confers disease resistance.

entries.name: Starcruiser Squid
entries.description: Cyber-bio squid. Cook to enhance tech damage.

entries.name: Frostcap Stew
entries.description: A discoverable recipe. Combine ice crystal + sprite dust + bear hide and cook to discover Frostcap Stew. Endurance +3 next battle.

entries.name: Hunter's Pie
entries.description: A discoverable recipe. Combine two bear claws and a wolf pelt to discover Hunter's Pie. Strength +3 next battle.

entries.name: Jester's Soufflé
entries.description: A discoverable recipe. Combine a memory shard and three sprite dust to discover Jester's Soufflé. Luck +4 next battle. Perfect cook adds +1.
